about_short_description.short_description: Hatchet is an orchestration platform for managing and observing AI agents, background tasks, and mission-critical workflows.

product.name: Hatchet Task Queue
product.description: A durable, fault-tolerant task queue that manages background tasks and ensures reliable delivery to workers without dropping tasks.

product.name: Hatchet Observability Features
product.description: Built-in monitoring, logging, and alerting tools to track task progress, detect failures, and notify users in real time.

product.name: Hatchet Cloud
product.description: A managed cloud service offering for running Hatchet’s task queue and workers with scalable compute resources.
